headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment features to improve ClearInstall’s local-first lockfile and install-surface auditor, ensuring users are informed about potential risks before running installations. This will enhance user trust and security.
actions: Add real-time risk analysis for binding.gyp command expansion to provide comprehensive visibility into potential installation risks.
Implement integration with public trend signals like Gathin23/cleanyourtv to detect and warn users about known vulnerabilities or malicious packages.
